map.输入统计期内的客户总数与流失客户数，计算客户流失率（Churn Rate），评估: Enter the total customer count and churned customers within the period to compute customer churn rate, assessing retention and business health.
map.月度看流失率判断留存健康度。: Review churn monthly to judge retention health.
map.由流失率推客户平均生命周期与 LTV。: Derive average customer lifetime and LTV from the churn rate.
map.分群对比付费/免费用户流失差异。: Compare churn between paying and free users by segment.
map.：期初 1000 人、当月流失 50 → 流失率=5%、留存率 95%；平均生命: : 1,000 customers at the start of the month, 50 churned -> churn rate = 5%, retention = 95%; average lifetime = 1/5% = 20 months; ARPU 100 CNY/month -> LTV (gross revenue) = 100/0.05 = 2,000 CNY.
map.：流失率≤3% 优秀、3–7% 良好、7–12% 一般、>12% 预警；某 Sa: : churn <= 3% excellent, 3-7% good, 7-12% fair, above 12% warning; a SaaS with 9% monthly churn is "fair" and needs win-back work.
map.流失率用人数还是金额？: Should churn rate use headcount or amount?
map.人数看活跃、金额看收入，高价值客户流失更伤，建议双指标监控。: Track churn by headcount for activity and by amount for revenue; losing high-value customers hurts more, so monitor both.
map.生命周期能直接当 LTV 吗？: Can lifetime be used directly as LTV?
map.生命周期×ARPU 是毛收入口径，扣成本与服务费才是净 LTV，且假设流失率恒定: Lifetime x ARPU is a gross revenue basis; deducting costs and service fees gives net LTV, and it assumes a constant churn rate.
